subject.title: [Task] Harden browser/search stack and evaluate Lightpanda

question: Should this broad browser/search hardening task remain an umbrella tracker, or should maintainers split it into narrower browser-backed access, external CDP/Lightpanda, and search-provider benchmark issues before any implementation?
rationale: Current main intentionally separates HTTP/provider web tools from the browser tool, and Lightpanda or browser-backed extraction would change security, session, and config boundaries that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
options.body: Keep this issue open only as planning context while maintainers move approved work to narrower issues for search-provider bugs, browser-backed extraction, and external CDP/Lightpanda support.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical maintainer-owned research tracker, but require explicit acceptance criteria and security boundaries before implementation starts.

options.title: Close After Linking Canonicals
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers decide the open browser-backed access and external CDP issues fully cover the remaining work.

recommendation.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open only as planning context while maintainers move approved work to narrower issues for search-provider bugs, browser-backed extraction, and external CDP/Lightpanda support.

likelyOwner.reason: The browser/search split, sandbox browser security history, and VISION.md product-boundary guidance point most strongly to steipete for the direction choice.
